channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Roy Hibbert | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Roy Hibbert from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Roy Hibbert, Jermaine O'Neal, Rik Smits, Myles Turner
item.description:
Alex Golden:Tyrese Haliburton on recording 3 blocks in a game for the 3rd time this season:

“I appreciate that Alex, thank you for recognizing that…so it goes: Myles Turner, Rik Smits, Jermaine O’Neal, Roy Hibbert, Tyrese Haliburton. That’s how it’s gonna end when I’m done here…but in my mindset, I’m the 5th best shot blocker in franchise history and you can’t tell me different.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Roy Hibbert, Jermaine O'Neal, Rik Smits, Myles Turner, Apr 11, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rich Cho on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Rich Cho on Roy Hibbert’s time in Charlotte:

“Well, I think thatwe had pretty high expectations when we signed Roy and, as you know, he had a really good first game, but then he had some injuries and it’s kind of tough to get in a rhythm, into a groove when you’re up and down with the injuries. Unfortunately, it didn’t work for Roy here, but one thing that you have to do when you’re a team, when you feel like something’s not working, [you have to] try and move on quickly.”

Rich Cho on Roy Hibbert, Feb 2, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Serena Winters:Kobe on Hibbert:

“Been absolutely solid. Defensively he's been great. Offensively he's been great & he's another great passer on this team.”

Kobe Bryant on Roy Hibbert, Oct 12, 2015. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Paul George on Roy Hibbert, Luis Scola, David West
item.description:
“Losing D-West, Roy (Hibbert via trade to the Los Angeles Lakers) and (veteran forward Luis) Scola (via free agency to the Toronto Raptors) were something that I didn’t see coming,”

Paul George on Roy Hibbert, Luis Scola, David West, Sep 27, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Carlos Boozer on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Kristina Leahy:Boozer on Hibbert:

“Started acting like a tough guy, and we all know he's not a tough guy.”

Carlos Boozer on Roy Hibbert, Jan 5, 2015. Source: Twitter @KristineLeahy.

item.title: David West on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Candace Buckner:David West on Hibbert:

“He probably said five words yesterday, we didn’t hear his voice. Today, very focused, he’s very subdued and again, it’s been about encouraging him and making sure he knows we got his back. We’re in this fight. This whole group, we’re going to fight tooth and nail to get out of this to advance and get out of this round.”

David West on Roy Hibbert, May 7, 2014. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: David West on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Scott Agness:A beyond furious David West, on Hibbert:

“He’s got to be part of the fight. H’s got to be part of this thing for us to go anywhere.”

David West on Roy Hibbert, May 5, 2014. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Marcin Gortat on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Michael Lee:Marcin Gortat on Roy Hibbert:

“I don’t want this guy to come in & drop 20 & 15 on me. So if he drops 0 & 2, I’m cool with that.”

Marcin Gortat on Roy Hibbert, May 5, 2014. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Paul George on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Paul George on Hibbert:

“We’re at the point where we really need Roy and we need him now.”

Paul George on Roy Hibbert, May 5, 2014. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
“He has not played well in the series to this point. But we still have confidence in Roy Hibbert.”

Frank Vogel on Roy Hibbert, Apr 25, 2014. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Spoelstra says Oden at his max minutes for now.

“Greg's not here to be a Hibbert stopper. Greg is here to make a championship team better.”

Erik Spoelstra on Roy Hibbert, Mar 26, 2014. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Frank Vogel on pictures of Roy Hibbert looking jacked:

“I think he’s got some photographers from Men’s Fitness on there doctoring them up or something because he looks pretty big in those pictures, doesn’t he? Naw, I’m just kidding. I saw him yesterday in my office. He’s really bulking up and really excited about just being even more of a physical presence, especially on the offensive end — really pounding defenders down low and playing our identify of smash-mouth basketball.”

Frank Vogel on Roy Hibbert, Aug 28, 2013. Source: Pacers.com.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Dwight Howard, Roy Hibbert
item.description:
said Van Gundy on Open Mike with Mike Bianchi on am740 the Game,

“You could put that question to 30 general managers in the league -- and give them the choice -- and Indiana, out of loyalty, might take Hibbert although I would doubt it. The other 29 would not even hesitate. Everybody's taking Dwight.”

Stan Van Gundy on Dwight Howard, Roy Hibbert, Jun 1, 2013. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Paul George on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Pacers forwardPaul George on not having Hibbert in the game:

“It was different. I’m used to being aggressive. That’s the reason why I was aggressive. I’m used to having Roy back there. But, again, me being in that situation, I’ve got to know who’s on the floor with me and know what we want from LeBron.”

Paul George on Roy Hibbert, May 23, 2013. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: David West on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Scott Agness:David West on Roy Hibbert:

“I think he's the best big defender in the league. He's anchored our defense all season.”

David West on Roy Hibbert, May 5, 2013. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Roy Hibbert
item.description:
Chris Haynes:LaMarcus Aldridge on no Roy Hibbert:

“I was disapointed. I definiltly felt like he would put us over that hump of being on the next level.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Roy Hibbert, Jul 20, 2012. Source: Twitter.
